home.title:
Your surveys.
Your results.
No hassle.
home.subtitle: Built for academic research and field data collection — theses, dissertations, clinical studies. Create, share and analyze in a few clicks.
home.feature1Desc: Participants answer via a simple link or code — no sign-up required.
home.feature2Desc: See trends as responses arrive, question by question.
home.feature3Desc: Full reports with crosstabs, frequencies and raw data.
home.feature4Desc: Auto-generated summary to help write up your findings.
home.feature5Desc: Mark important questions and validate mandatory answers.
home.feature6Desc: Build your survey from scratch with drafts and preview.

home.answerDesc: Enter the code you received or open the share link.
home.loginDesc: Access your space and your results

wizard.guideIntro: Create your survey by following these steps:
wizard.guideStep1: Choose « Blank survey » to start the step-by-step wizard.
wizard.guideStep2: Enter a title and description to give context to your survey.
wizard.guideStep3: Add your questions (single choice, multiple choice, rating, number, or free text).
wizard.guideStep4: Mark important questions with the « Required » badge when an answer is mandatory.
wizard.guideStep5: Preview, save as draft if needed, then publish and share the code or link.
wizard.editPublishedNote: The share code and link stay the same. Avoid deleting questions that already have answers — existing responses are linked to them.
